subject: Request: one-time launch credit + 60-day trial extension for NebulaAI POC
messages:
From: Rachel Lin <rachel.lin@nebula.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Sato <tom.sato@nebula.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask: launch credit + trial extension for POC

Hi Soojin —

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday. We got internal feedback from engineering and product and they want to expand the POC scope to include streaming inference and a larger prompt set. Two asks from our side to make the expanded POC possible this sprint: 1) a one-time $12k credit to buffer the token spend while we ramp, and 2) a 60-day trial extension so our SREs can run stability tests on a longer window.

We have a signed SOW draft (attached) and a short usage snapshot from the first week. If we can get the credits + term, we can commit to a commercial pilot with a $120k first-year forecast if results look good.

Can you let us know if that combination is possible and what approvals you need?

Thanks —
Rachel
Rachel Lin
Head of Product, Nebula AI
--
Attachment: NebulaAI_PoC_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: nebula_usage_apr.csv (csv)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Lin <rachel.lin@nebula.ai>
Cc: Tom Sato <tom.sato@nebula.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: launch credit + trial extension for POC

Hi Rachel —

Appreciate the write-up and the SOW. Short answer: we can consider a blended concession (credit + extension) but this needs an exec approval because the combined value is outside standard SDR-approved thresholds. Ive opened a quick internal thread to scope the exact ask and confirm constraints.

Proposed interim offer while we get signoff: 30k token-equivalent credit (to address immediate spend) and a 30-day extension as a fallback. If execs approve, were prepared to move to the full $12k credit + 60 days.

Can you confirm the timeline for the expanded POC start (aiming to keep this week or early next) and whether Nebula can sign the SOW with the credit recognized as a promotional credit on the invoice? That helps procurement.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Contact: +1 (415) 555-0147

Marissa / Ben —

Looping you in for quick exec approval. Customer Nebula AI (Rachel Lin) is requesting a combined concession: $12k one-time promotional credit + 60-day trial extension to cover expanded POC scope (streaming inference + larger prompt set). They indicate a potential $120k first-year ARR if POC converts.

Attached are the SOW and a small usage report. Key points:
- Current trial spend rate suggests the $12k credit is a reasonable buffer if they run streaming tests.
- We already have a signed draft SOW and procurement is engaged (theyve asked that the credit appear on the invoice).
- I proposed a provisional offer (30k-equivalent token credit + 30 days) to buy time for approval.

Request: Can you confirm if we can approve the full $12k + 60 days? If not, what middle ground should I offer? Time pressure: they want to ramp testing this week.

Thanks —
Soojin

Attachments: NebulaAI_PoC_SOW_v1.pdf, nebula_usage_apr.csv

Thanks for the context, Soojin. Reviewed the SOW and usage snapshot. I'm comfortable approving the full concession with two firm conditions:

1) Nebula signs the SOW by EOD Friday (2027-04-23) to trigger the credit.
2) We add a clause limiting promotional credit usage to POC workloads (we will not apply it to production traffic); procurement must initial that line.

If they meet both conditions, approve $12k promotional credit + 60-day extension. Ben, please confirm finance will record as a promotional adjustment (not revenue) and patch the invoice template.

Marissa
